name: crates.io API
tagline: Public API for the Rust package registry
description: HTTP API for crates.io, the official Rust package registry. Query crate metadata, versions, downloads, owners, and dependencies; used by Cargo and tooling to discover and inspect packages.

auth.details: Read endpoints are public with no auth. Write/authenticated operations use a crates.io API token (Bearer) from account settings.

use_cases: look up crate metadata by name
list crate versions and download counts
